_readme: Owner: Set C. The mission list at the top right of the screen, one entry per chapter id (see STORY.md section 8). The HUD shows the English text; the Arabic is kept beside it so both can be edited together. Chapters call hud.setMission('moon') and hud.completeTask(0), (1)... in the order below. epilogue_photo is the new 1973 opening phase, followed by epilogue for the imagined listening scene. The epilogue runs both phases in order; existing epilogue task indexes are unchanged.

tasks.en: Take the crew to 3 science stops
Secure 3 boxes of the crew’s geology samples

tasks.ar: اكشط الصخر وحلّل أثر الماء فيه
